Counter + heap by frequency. O(n log k).

For top k freq basic I will count then heappushpop until k remain.

```python
from collections import Counter
import heapq
def top_k(nums, k):
    c = Counter(nums)
    return heapq.nlargest(k, c.keys(), key=c.get)
```
